title: Pope Leo XIV Discharged from Hospital Following Lung Surgery
subtitle: The 71-year-old leader returns to the Vatican after a successful operation to remove a cancerous growth.

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV has left Gemelli Hospital in Rome just five days after undergoing lung surgery. Doctors confirmed that his recovery is progressing well following the removal of a cancerous tumor. The Pope was seen walking without assistance as he departed the medical facility. He is expected to resume his public duties, including the traditional Angelus prayer, this Sunday. Despite the surgery, his medical team believes he may still be able to travel for his planned trip to Latin America in November.
summary.zh: 教宗利奧十四世在接受肺部手術僅五天後，已離開羅馬的傑梅利醫院。醫師證實，在切除癌性腫瘤後，他的復原狀況良好。教宗離開醫療機構時被目擊能自行步行。預計他將於本週日恢復公開職務，包括主持傳統的三鐘經祈禱。儘管經歷了手術，醫療團隊認為他仍有望按計畫於十一月前往拉丁美洲出訪。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV has been discharged from Gemelli Hospital in Rome, returning to the Vatican just five days after a major operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung. The 71-year-old leader, who became the first US-born head of the Roman Catholic Church last year, was seen walking out of the hospital on Saturday afternoon without any physical support. He stopped briefly to wave to well-wishers who had gathered to support him.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗利奧十四世（Pope Leo XIV）已從羅馬的傑梅利醫院（Gemelli Hospital）出院，在接受切除肺部腫瘤的大手術僅五天後，便返回梵蒂岡。這位七十一歲的領袖去年成為首位美國出生的羅馬天主教會元首，週六下午被目擊在沒有任何輔助的情況下步行走出醫院。他短暫停下腳步，向聚集在現場為他打氣的民眾揮手致意。

paragraphs.en: According to BBC News, the Pope’s medical team, led by Professor Stefano Margaritora and personal physician Dr. Luigi Carbone, confirmed that the decision to discharge him followed positive results from recent blood tests and a chest X-ray. These tests showed that his condition is improving steadily. The surgery, which took place on Tuesday and lasted 90 minutes, involved the removal of the lower lobe of his right lung to extract a tumor identified as adenocarcinoma. The Guardian World reports that this is the most common type of lung cancer, and doctors are currently waiting for further test results to determine if the cancer has spread or if additional treatment will be necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）報導，由史蒂法諾·馬加里托拉教授（Professor Stefano Margaritora）與私人醫師路易吉·卡波內（Dr. Luigi Carbone）領導的醫療團隊證實，出院決定是基於近期血液檢查與胸部X光片的正面結果。這些檢測顯示他的病情正穩定好轉。這場於週二進行、歷時九十分鐘的手術，切除了他右肺的下葉，以取出被鑑定為腺癌的腫瘤。《衛報》（The Guardian）報導指出，這是最常見的肺癌類型，醫師目前正等待進一步檢測結果，以判定癌症是否擴散，或是否需要後續治療。

paragraphs.en: Despite the serious nature of the surgery, the Pope has remained active during his hospital stay. NPR News notes that he celebrated Mass in a private room on the 10th floor of the hospital before his departure. Furthermore, the Vatican announced that the Pope held a phone call with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Friday. During this conversation, the Pope urged for a ceasefire—an agreement to stop fighting—in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky. He specifically requested that this pause in fighting be used to allow for the safe delivery of food and medicine to residents, who have been struggling under constant shelling.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管手術性質嚴重，教宗在住院期間仍保持活躍。美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR News）指出，他在出院前於醫院十樓的私人房間內主持了彌撒。此外，梵蒂岡宣布教宗週五與俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）進行了通話。在對話中，教宗敦促在俄軍佔領的烏克蘭城市奧列什基（Oleshky）實施停火，即達成停止戰鬥的協議。他特別要求利用這段停火期間，讓糧食與藥品能安全運送給當地居民，這些居民正飽受持續不斷的砲擊之苦。

paragraphs.en: This rapid recovery has come as a surprise to many, as the Vatican had initially estimated that the Pope would need to stay in the hospital for at least a week. While his public schedule remains cleared until October 20, the Vatican confirmed that he will return to his duties this Sunday to lead the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing from the window of the papal apartment. This is a significant step, as the Pope had shocked the world just last week when he personally announced his diagnosis and upcoming surgery during the same Sunday prayer event.
paragraphs.zh: 這種迅速的康復令許多人感到驚訝，因為梵蒂岡起初預估教宗至少需要住院一週。雖然他直到十月二十日前的公開行程仍維持取消，但梵蒂岡證實，他將於本週日恢復職務，從教宗寓所的窗戶主持傳統的三鐘經祈禱與祝福儀式。這是一個重要的進展，因為教宗上週才在同樣的週日祈禱活動中，親自宣布自己的診斷結果與即將進行的手術，震驚了全世界。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, there is growing interest in whether the Pope will be able to maintain his international travel plans. He is scheduled to visit Latin America in early November, including a trip to Peru, where he previously served as a missionary. While some might expect a long recovery, his surgeon, Dr. Stefano Margaritora, told Vatican media that there are currently no clinical reasons to prevent the trip. He noted that the Pope has shown great dedication to his recovery and expects him to be fully recovered in about ten days. Experts not involved in his care, such as Dr. Vin Gupta of the American Lung Association, have noted that the Pope’s general health and active lifestyle—which includes playing tennis and riding horses—likely contributed to his robust recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，外界日益關注教宗是否能維持其國際出訪計畫。他預計於十一月初訪問拉丁美洲，行程包括他曾擔任傳教士的秘魯。雖然有些人可能預期需要漫長的恢復期，但他的主治醫師馬加里托拉向梵蒂岡媒體表示，目前沒有臨床理由阻止這趟行程。他指出教宗展現了極大的復原決心，預計約十天內即可完全康復。未參與其照護的專家，例如美國肺臟協會（American Lung Association）的文·古普塔醫師（Dr. Vin Gupta）則指出，教宗的整體健康狀況與活躍的生活方式（包括打網球與騎馬）很可能促成了他強健的復原力。

paragraphs.en: For now, the focus remains on his immediate health and the upcoming results of his post-surgery tests. The Vatican has not yet announced any further medical procedures. For Catholics around the world, the Pope’s quick return home and his plan to appear in public so soon provide a sense of relief following a week of concern regarding his health. As he settles back into the Vatican, the international community will be watching closely to see if he can successfully return to his full schedule and proceed with his planned diplomatic travels next month.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，焦點仍集中在他的即時健康狀況以及術後檢測的後續結果。梵蒂岡尚未宣布任何進一步的醫療程序。對於全球天主教徒而言，教宗能如此迅速返家並計畫在短時間內公開露面，在經歷了一週對其健康的擔憂後，帶來了一種寬慰感。隨著他回到梵蒂岡安頓，國際社會將密切關注他是否能順利恢復完整行程，並按計畫進行下個月的外交出訪。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To officially allow someone to leave a hospital.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「解僱」或「釋放」，這裡指醫療上的出院。文中：Pope Leo XIV has been discharged from Gemelli Hospital in Rome, returning to the Vatican just five days after a major operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Empty or free from scheduled events.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「清除」或「變晴朗」，這裡形容行程表被清空。文中：While his public schedule remains cleared until October 20, the Vatican confirmed that he will return to his duties this Sunday to lead the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing from the window of the papal apartment.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To return to a normal routine or comfortable state after a period of change.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「定居」，這裡指病後恢復正常生活節奏。文中：As he settles back into the Vatican, the international community will be watching closely to see if he can successfully return to his full schedule and proceed with his planned diplomatic travels next month.

quiz.question: What specific action did Pope Leo XIV take regarding the conflict in Ukraine while he was still hospitalized?

options.A: He issued a public statement through the Vatican press office calling for peace.
options.B: He spoke directly with the Russian President to advocate for a temporary halt in military activities.
options.C: He sent a personal letter to the residents of Oleshky promising them humanitarian aid.
options.D: He held a special prayer service specifically for the soldiers fighting in Oleshky.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，教宗在住院期間與俄羅斯總統普丁進行了電話交談，並敦促其在奧列什基（Oleshky）實行停火（ceasefire），以便運送糧食與藥品。選項 A 錯誤，因為他是透過電話直接溝通而非僅透過新聞辦公室發表聲明；選項 C 錯誤，文中未提及他寫信給居民；選項 D 錯誤，他是在私人房間舉行彌撒，而非為士兵舉辦特別祈禱儀式。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the Pope's recovery progress compared to the Vatican's initial expectations?

options.A: It is proceeding exactly as the medical team predicted before the surgery.
options.B: It is slower than anticipated, causing the Vatican to clear his schedule until October 20.
options.C: It is happening faster than the Vatican originally thought possible.
options.D: It is uncertain, as the doctors are still debating whether he needs more surgery.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。第四段提到教宗的快速康復讓許多人感到驚訝，因為梵蒂岡原本預計他至少需要住院一週，但他僅五天就出院了。選項 A 錯誤，因為實際康復速度快於預期；選項 B 雖然提到行程清空，但這是預防措施，而非康復緩慢；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到目前沒有理由阻止他出國旅遊，且沒有提到醫生對手術結果有爭議。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'robust' mean in the context of the Pope's recovery?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到教宗因平時喜愛網球與騎馬等活動，擁有良好的健康基礎，這造就了他「robust」的康復狀況。在此語境下，robust 形容身體強健、恢復力佳。選項 B (粗糙的) 與語意不符；選項 C (緩慢的) 與文章描述的「快速康復」矛盾；選項 D (令人震驚的) 雖然人們對康復速度感到驚訝，但 robust 本身並非指「震驚」之意。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this news report?

options.A: To analyze the political implications of the Pope's phone call with Vladimir Putin.
options.B: To provide a detailed medical breakdown of the risks associated with adenocarcinoma.
options.C: To update the public on the Pope's health status and his return to official duties following surgery.
options.D: To criticize the Vatican for not being transparent about the Pope's initial diagnosis.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章從教宗出院、手術後的狀況、住院期間的活動，到未來的行程規劃，核心主旨都在報導教宗的健康狀況與術後恢復情形。選項 A 僅是文章的一小部分細節；選項 B 過於偏向醫學專業，文章並未深入探討癌症風險；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未批評梵蒂岡，且教宗本人親自公開了診斷結果，顯示其具備透明度。
